Found by the close-run-1 review swarm's mixed-family delta lane (Opus verifying Sol's 94ae538) while checking whether the hardcoded-path defect class survives elsewhere: it does.

`scripts/bakeoff-export.ts:19` — OUT prefers `process.env.TMPDIR` (banned outright by repo standards: never /tmp, $TMPDIR, or mktemp -d — sandbox-local, invisible to runners and the operator) and falls back to the literal `/Volumes/ThunderBolt/_tmp/open-brain/_scratch`, which does not exist on Linux CI.

Failure modes: TMPDIR unset on Linux → write fails; TMPDIR set → output lands sandbox-local and invisible. Fix shape (same as 94ae538): derive from repoRoot + gitignored `out/`. Also sweep: `rg -n '/Volumes/ThunderBolt' scripts/ --type ts` for other members of the class.

Epic: none (tooling hygiene); candidate for the overnight mechanical batch. SME: promote the pattern (module-top-level absolute paths / TMPDIR in repo tooling) to docs/sme/quality.md.
